data.title: Debt collection demand for an unpaid garden centre order (€282.51)
data.summary: Beispiel Inkasso Service GmbH, acting on behalf of Beispiel Gartenmarkt GmbH, demands payment of a total claim of €282.51 (unpaid invoice GM-26-77410 of €236.40, plus default interest and collection costs) for a raised-bed order delivered on 18 November 2026, to be paid by 2 March 2027.
data.explanation: This is a demand letter from a debt collection agency (Inkassodienstleister), not a court order, so it has no immediate enforceable force by itself. You should either pay the total amount by the stated deadline, or, if you believe the claim is wrong, write to the agency within the same period explaining why. If you do nothing and the claim is justified, the creditor could later take legal steps such as applying for a court order (Mahnbescheid). If you're unsure whether the underlying invoice is correct, it may help to check your order records or seek independent advice before paying or replying.
